sentences.text: Priya Nair (S1) is from adult social care and spoke with Margaret Doyle (S2) on Monday (L1).
The assessment is happening because the hospital sent a referral when Margaret was discharged (L23).
The purpose of the visit is a needs assessment under the Care Act (L24).
S1 mentioned that 'he wants to sign them' (L676).
Margaret reported that she fell on the third of March, which was a Monday (L52).
Margaret was in the kitchen making tea when she fell (L54).
Margaret was unsure if she tripped or if she just went dizzy when she fell (L55).
Margaret was on the floor by the back door for about two hours (L56, L61).
Margaret was found by Brenda next door because the curtains were not drawn and the kitchen light was not on (L63).
Brenda rang the ambulance and stayed with Margaret until the ambulance arrived (L66).
S1 asked S2 about toilet use and the stairs (L216, L217).
S2 stated that sometimes she does not make it to the toilet in time, mentioning the stairs and a bit of leaking (L220, L221).
S2 currently wears pads at night, which she buys from the supermarket, and Kevin gets them for her (L223, L224).
S1 suggested S2 might be interested in seeing the continence service, which could potentially provide free pads, advice, and exercises (L225, L226).
S2 agreed to the continence service if it was free (L227).
Kevin Doyle stated that the house is too much for Margaret now due to the stairs and the garden (L337).
Kevin Doyle suggested Margaret might be better off in a sheltered flat or a bungalow, with everything on one level and a warden on site (L338, L339).
S2 stated she has not smoked for thirty years (L456).
S2 stated her memory is 'alright. Mostly,' noting she sometimes forgets where she has put her glasses (L458).
Margaret expressed that she does not want to be put anywhere (L29).
Margaret Doyle stated that she is not moving, Kevin (L340).
Margaret stated that she is willing to share what is discussed with her GP and anyone involved in her support (L43).
S2 advised S1 to 'Mind how you go in that wind' (L677).
S2 advised S1 to 'Mind the step' (L680).
Margaret mentioned that her son, Kevin, might visit around half eleven (L48).
S3 stated they would see S1 on the fifteenth (L679).
